# Architecture: acme-api

Monorepo. Workspace managed with pnpm workspaces (`pnpm-workspace.yaml`) and Turborepo (`turbo.json`). Workspace patterns: `apps/*`, `packages/*`.

## Workspace packages

| Package | Path | Ecosystem | Frameworks | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `@acme/api` | `apps/api` | Node.js | Fastify | – |
| `@acme/web` | `apps/web` | Node.js | Nuxt, Vue | – |
| `@acme/ui` | `packages/ui` | Node.js | Vue | 0.3.0 |
| `github.com/acme/billing` | `services/billing` | Go | net/http | – |

## Entry points

- `services/billing` — Go `main` package
- `acme` → `packages/cli/bin/acme.js` — package.json `bin` command

## Top-level structure

- `apps/` — 84 files
- `packages/` — 41 files
- `services/` — 12 files
- `.github/` — 3 files

## Services

| Service | Image / build | Ports | Depends on | Kind | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `postgres` | `postgres:17` | 5432 → 5432 | – | database · PostgreSQL | healthcheck |
| `redis` | `redis:8` | 6379 → 6379 | – | cache · Redis | – |
| `minio` | `minio/minio` | 9000 → 9000, 9001 → 9001 | – | storage · MinIO | – |

## Dockerfiles

- `apps/api/Dockerfile` — base image `node:20-alpine`; exposes 4000

## Databases

| Database | Kind | Detected via | Confidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PostgreSQL | relational | Docker, config, env | high |
| Redis | key-value | Docker, env | high |

ORMs and query builders: Prisma 6.16.2 (`apps/api`).

## How the pieces fit together

- `apps/api`: Fastify · 3 API routes · data access with Prisma
- `apps/web`: Nuxt, Vue · 1 API route · 2 pages
- `packages/ui`: Vue
- `services/billing`: net/http · 1 API route
- `apps/web` reads `API_URL` (http, port 4000), the port `apps/api/Dockerfile` exposes.
- `apps/api` reads `DATABASE_URL` (postgres, port 5432), the port the `postgres` service publishes.
- `apps/api` reads `REDIS_URL` (redis, port 6379), the port the `redis` service publishes.
